description: This PHP source file implements the detail view page for SalesOrder records within the SugarCRM ecosystem, handling data retrieval, permission checks, UI assignment, and rendering the DetailView template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Core class for CRM entity operations, with a static method getInstance for retrieving entity objects.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper specific to vtiger CRM environment, used for rendering views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Loads entity data into the CRMEntity object based on record ID and module.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves UI blocks for the given module and view type.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Generates update info information for display.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number for the module record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the field used for module sequence numbering.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for actions on records.

methods.name: getDetailAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves associated product records for the current SalesOrder.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for specified table and tab ID.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into separate arrays for fields, types, and labels.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission for specific custom fields.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks for certain UI button permissions or conditions.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if there are related lists to display.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related list data for the current module and record.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in the detail view.

methods.name: ListViewSession::getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Retrieves navigation info for list view sessions.

methods.name: Vtiger_Link::getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves custom links by type for the module.
